speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify the nature of your symptoms: Is your double vision constant or does it change when you look left or right? Also, have you noticed any trouble swallowing or speaking?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of weakness worsening with activity and improving with rest is very concerning for myasthenia gravis, especially given your vertical diplopia. Have you noticed any drooping of your eyelids (ptosis) or difficulty swallowing foods?
